questions.questionText: Which action would help to limit the development of antibiotic resistance in bacteria?

options.text: Use antibiotics frequently to prevent infection by antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
Use antibiotics only to treat bacterial infections.
Use antibiotics to treat all types of infections.
Use antibiotics to treat only viral infections.

questions.questionText: What is an example of asexual reproduction?

a mammal giving birth to four offspring
a female bird laying six eggs which will hatch into the same species
a tomato plant producing fruits which contain many seeds

questions.questionText: Why are lymphocytes the only cells that produce antibody proteins?

options.text: Lymphocytes express all the genes in the nucleus.
Lymphocytes have twice as many genes as other cells.
Other cells do not have the genes for antibodies.
The genes for antibodies are only expressed in lymphocytes.

questions.questionText: During protein synthesis, what is the function of the ribosome?

options.text: It assembles amino acids in a chain.
It carries a copy of a gene to the cytoplasm.
It contains the code for the synthesis of a protein.
It determines the order of bases in the protein.

questions.questionText:
